pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions unless the primary trade is in-the-money by at least 2.5x the initial risk threshold and volatility confirms a directional breakout.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 3-candle momentum confirmation and volume delta spike before authorizing execution, filtering out low-liquidity micro-wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$10.00, trail remaining position with an aggressive volatility envelope to capture extended runs to +$25.00+.
